verdicts.title: On existence of shift-type invariant subspaces for polynomially bounded operator
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: A particular case of results from [K2] is as follows. Let the unitary asymptote of a contraction $T$ contain the bilateral shift (of finite or infinite multiplicity). Then there exists an invariant subspace $\mathcal M$ of $T$ such that $T|_{\mathcal M}$ is similar to the unilateral shift of the same multiplicity. verdicts.title: Polynomial bounds for chromatic number. IV. A near-polynomial bound for excluding the five-vertex path
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: A graph G is H-free if it has no induced subgraph isomorphic to H. We prove that a $P_5$-free graph with clique number $ω\ge 3$ has chromatic number at most $ω^{\log_2(ω)}$. The best previous result was an exponential upper bound $(5/27)3^ω$, due to Esperet, Lemoine, Maffray, and Morel.
